about: H3f mutants of hosts/mygo and its drawing module. scripts/mutants measures the Ergo module only; each edit here is applied to a scratch copy of the repository without .git (the layout tests build bin/ergo from it; an H2L mutant edits std ui/layout, which only hosts/mygo's oracle holds to MyGo), then, when the edit is to drawing/internal/drawgen, drawgen runs in drawing/ (as go generate would after the edit), then the killers run. A killer is module:Test, where module is drawing or mygo.

mutants.name: H3f-consts-dropped
mutants.rule: every exported constant of a drawing-layer package is mirrored

mutants.name: H3f-args-reordered
mutants.rule: a wrapper calls the internal function with its parameters in order

mutants.name: H3f-layer-dropped
mutants.rule: the export reaches every layer a host draws with

mutants.name: H3f-hand-edit
mutants.rule: the drawing packages are what drawgen writes from the pinned MyGo

mutants.name: H2L-gap-after-last
mutants.rule: a gap goes between children, not after the last

mutants.name: H2L-grow-by-count
mutants.rule: free space is shared by grow weight, not by count

mutants.name: H2L-cross-padding-ignored
mutants.rule: a row places its children inside its padding across the line

mutants.name: H2L-dirty-not-propagated
mutants.rule: a change forgets what the nodes up to the root computed

mutants.name: H2L-no-reuse
mutants.rule: a box laid out at its size with nothing changed in it is kept, not computed again

mutants.name: H3g-hit-first
mutants.from:
if inside(s, x, y) {
				hit = Some{Value: s}
mutants.rule: the hit test takes the node painted last under the point: a button over an Area takes the tap

mutants.name: H3g-tab-reversed
mutants.from: let next = if back { (at + n - 1) % n } else { (at + 1) % n }
mutants.to: let next = if back { (at + 1) % n } else { (at + n - 1) % n }
mutants.rule: Tab moves the focus forward in paint (tree) order, Shift+Tab back

mutants.name: H3g-fill-off-its-box
mutants.to: fill(d, layout.Box{X: b.X, Y: b.Y + 6, W: b.W, H: b.H}, 6, button)
mutants.rule: a node's fill is painted on the box the layout gave it, where the hit test finds it

mutants.name: H3g-backspace-keeps-text
mutants.rule: Backspace in the focused field removes its last rune

mutants.name: H3g-release-dropped
mutants.to:
case Some[spot[E]] as s:
				let _ = s
			case None:
mutants.rule: a release with no press goes to the Area under it

mutants.name: H3g-go-directive-dropped
mutants.rule: a program that binds this module (which needs Go 1.27.3, as MyGo does) builds: the emitted go.mod states the later go version

mutants.name: X-gui-row-below-the-fold-not-scrolled-to
mutants.rule: a step on a row below its Scroll's fold scrolls to it first, as a person does, so it presses that row and not the one painted over its box

mutants.name: X-gui-window-binary-prints-the-start
mutants.rule: the window binary prints the state the window's driver holds after each step

mutants.name: W1-binding-off-the-browser
mutants.rule: the window binaries build for Windows and the browser: screen's binding states windows/amd64 and js/wasm, where it holds (ergo bind go)

mutants.name: GPh-row-at-the-written-index
mutants.rule: a list's row shows at its index's place, counted from the list's First, not from the first row written

mutants.name: GPh-viewport-not-reported
mutants.rule: the window reports a list's viewport, so the next pass writes the rows it shows

mutants.name: GPh-list-gets-no-room
mutants.rule: a list with no height of its own takes the window below its top

mutants.name: GPh-list-not-stretched
mutants.rule: a list is as wide as its parent, and its rows as wide as the list

mutants.name: GPh-scroll-on-does-nothing
mutants.rule: ScrollOn scrolls the list to its offset, or as far as its content goes

mutants.name: GPh-wheel-misses-lists
mutants.from:
case ui.ScrollNode, ui.RowsNode:
				target = Some{Value: s}
mutants.rule: the wheel scrolls the list under the pointer

mutants.name: GPh-canvas-transform-dropped
mutants.from:
stack = stack.Append(pushed{was: m, clip: false})
			m = compose(m, x.M)
mutants.to:
stack = stack.Append(pushed{was: m, clip: false})
			m = compose(m, ui.Scale(x.M.A, x.M.D))
mutants.rule: a canvas paints under the transforms its list pushes

mutants.name: GPh-fill-spans-outside
mutants.rule: a path's fill covers where its winding number is not zero
